message.content:
Step 1: Identify the German aircraft and aircraft engine manufacturer whose former engineers designed the Pirna 014. According to the source [Pirna 014], the Pirna 014 was designed by former Junkers engineers.
Step 2: Identify the city where this manufacturer was based. According to the source [Junkers], Junkers was based in Dessau, Germany.
Final answer: Dessau
